lines.zh: 腿拖着，一步一步挪过去。
lines.en: One dragging step at a time.

lines.zh: 街上的砖碎了，我踩过去。
lines.en: The bricks are broken; I shuffle across them.
I've walked this street a thousand times.

lines.zh: 气味在前头，我就跟着走。
lines.en: The smell is ahead, so I follow it.
My ankle is crooked, but I keep going.
I drift slowly between the ruins.
I drag one foot after you.
My shadow is long and I still have to walk.
One step, one sound, like dragging a sack.
There's living scent up ahead.

lines.zh: 街道空得只剩我的脚步。
lines.en: The street is empty except for my footsteps.
I go around the fallen wall and keep walking.
I sway where I stand; I never tire.
Only a gurgle is left in my throat.
The wind rattles my rags.
I wait here for someone to pass.
My head is empty; only hunger remains.
The sun shines and I feel no warmth.
One hand still hangs in the air.
I forget where I was going.
A joint clicks, then silence.
I stand at the crossing, recognizing no one.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我看见了。
lines.en: You're warm; I can see it.
Our eyes met — don't run.
I see your eyes catching the light.
A living face, after so long.
The way you breathe is so fresh.

lines.zh: 我记得这张脸吗？不记得。
lines.en: Do I know that face? No.
Don't hide behind the wall; I see you.
You gasp, and my head comes up.
I lift my head, wanting one bite.
You stand still — what a waste.
It hurts — no, I don't feel it.
Another hit — hold steady.
My arm is nearly off.
My neck cricks and I straighten up.
Good aim, but I'm still walking.
Another bone cracks.
I stagger back two steps, still walking.
Piercing my hide gets you nowhere.
Stop hitting; I'll remember you.
The pain comes slow and leaves slower.
The smell of meat — which way?
A raw, meaty scent drifts downwind.
I smell that bag of yours.
Hungry too long; I'd eat anything.
Whatever's in your hand — one bite.
I shuffle toward the smell.
Fresh things always make noise.
Let me get closer and sniff.
That smell makes me restless.
Food, food, just ahead.
I bumped you; don't shove.
You're in my way.
My shoulder's against you — move.
This close, I bite.
I bump you, you bump back.
So hard — is that armor?
Don't crowd me; I can't stand straight.
Half a step back would do.
Even walkers bump into each other.

lines.zh: 碰撞声引来了别的家伙。
lines.en: That bump drew others.
We crowd together and shuffle.
You're dead too? Good.
Traveling together, the scent is stronger.
We breed nothing; we only spread.
We walk together; neither shakes the other.
Two corpses, one hunger.
You follow me; I follow the smell.
Shuffle side by side; don't fall behind.
Our little horde just grew.
The dead don't court; we pick a direction.
Can I bite this? I'll pick it up.
A scrap of cloth — I grab it.
You dropped it; it's mine.
I pick up a stone and carry it.
My hand reaches out and closes on it.
This iron scrap has some weight.
Everything I find goes into my rags.
I clutch it and shuffle on.
I clutch it and won't let go.
Even a bone counts as a find.
I see you — the chase starts.
You moved, so I follow.
Target confirmed: alive.

lines.zh: 你跑的那一下我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the way you bolted.
The smell of blood has you pinned.
Finally, someone not playing dead.
I turn and head for you.
Don't think stone will stop me.
You made a sound — good.
One catch at a time.
Suddenly my legs aren't slow.
What I want is on you.
Locked on; no switching.
Climbing won't save you.
From now on: you run, I chase.
Still running? I hear you.
A step, another step — closer.
You circle; I circle.
You stumbled, and I heard it.
I can tell you ran; your sweat is thicker.
The door's shut; I'll break it.
Your breathing's getting heavier.
I don't tire. Truly.
Hiding in a chest? Too cramped.
My arm reaches out, just short.
I step in your prints; they're still warm.
I see your torchlight.
Behind you — right behind.
The more you fear, the faster I get.
I can cut off this path.
Climb your ladder; I'll wait.
Three of you; I'll take the nearest.
Don't stop — stopping is the end.
My teeth are in your arm.
I've got my teeth in and I won't let go.
I've got you — stop struggling.
My nails dig into your sleeve.
You bleed, and the smell gets sweeter.
My swing lands on your shoulder.
I bite down and tear a piece off.
You retreat; I still press on.
My teeth are loose, but they work.
Just fall; save your strength.
The tearing echoes down the alley.
I can bite through plate like that.
That one made you stumble.
My hand closes on your collar.
I missed; I'm back at once.
Does it hurt? I forgot long ago.
I crawl out of the rubble.

lines.zh: 这具身体是谁的？无所谓。
lines.en: Whose body is this? Doesn't matter.
My eyes open on a grey world.
At the street's end, I rise.
I'm back again — don't be surprised.
The soil parts and I climb out.
I climb out of the storm drain.
No sun above, only smoke.
I smell people nearby.
One more shadow in the ruins.
First I stand, then I think.

lines.zh: 这地方我来过，不记得了。
lines.en: I've been here; I don't recall.
One, two — I lose count.
My neck cracks and I can move.
I'm on fire; my flesh crackles.
I fell from high up; my leg is worse.
Water pours in and I can't swallow.
The blast throws me into a wall.
An arrow sticks in my chest.
Strange force burns through my bones.
Hunger has left me skin and bone.
Lightning strikes and I spasm.

lines.zh: 底下一片空，我在往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing below; I keep falling.
